title: Summary: Setting Up Git
objective: Check for Git, make a practice repository, set its identity, and print both results.
hint: First the if line with Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue, printing Git is installed. Then Set-Location to C:\Development\git-practice, git init -q -b main, the two git config lines without --global, and Write-Output with Identity: and $(git config user.name).
